description: Candidate element inventory: hydrophobic moment versus insertion depth for every helix, and the size of exposed nonpolar versus charged surface patches
code:
import os, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
A=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,'amphipathic_helix_scan.csv'))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
a=ax[0]
col=['#c0392b' if d>0 else '#7f8c8d' for d in A.max_depth]
a.scatter(A.max_depth,A.muH,s=70,c=col,edgecolor='k',lw=.5,zorder=3)
for _,r in A.iterrows():
    if r.muH>0.45 or r.max_depth>5:
        a.annotate('%s %s'%(r.best_window,r.seq),(r.max_depth,r.muH),fontsize=7,
                   xytext=(4,4),textcoords='offset points')
a.axvline(0,color='k',lw=.8); a.axhline(0.5,ls='--',color='#999',lw=.8)
a.set_xlabel('deepest insertion of the helix below the fitted membrane surface (A)')
a.set_ylabel('hydrophobic moment per residue (Eisenberg, 100 deg)')
a.set_title('A. Only one helix combines a high hydrophobic moment\nwith insertion into the fitted bilayer',fontsize=9)
a=ax[1]
np_=[2172,549,519,409,383]; ch=[173,150,145,134,131]
x=np.arange(5); w=.38
a.bar(x-w/2,np_,w,color='#e67e22',label='exposed nonpolar patches')
a.bar(x+w/2,ch,w,color='#2980b9',label='exposed charged patches')
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(['1st','2nd','3rd','4th','5th'])
a.set_xlabel('patch rank by area'); a.set_ylabel('patch area (A2)')
a.set_title('B. No basic patch large enough to read anionic headgroups:\nthe largest charged patch is 173 A2 against 2172 A2 nonpolar',fontsize=9)
a.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
